title: Exact preparation geometry, toolpaths and held assessment in both working views
summary: Normal Wright workspace and actual isolated engineering run. No mocked routes or physical action.

manualSteps.label: Open process
manualSteps.instruction: Open the proof workspace, click Workflows, choose the saved wheel process and click Use saved process.

manualSteps.label: Inspect the held preparation run
manualSteps.instruction: Open the recorded second-run link and inspect its preparation results and human-review hold.

manualSteps.label: Reuse the interface
manualSteps.instruction: Click Create or choose interface, select Focus-wheel configured preparation and click Open saved interface.

manualSteps.label: Inspect geometry
manualSteps.instruction: Reload the saved working interface, then click Open representation on repaired_mesh.stl.

manualSteps.label: Inspect producer
manualSteps.instruction: Return to the saved interface and click Open producing step on repaired_mesh.stl.

steps.label: Installed preparation workspace
steps.summary: Continue the retained walkthrough at its first unverified assessment.
steps.purpose: Reuse the same isolated installed host without replaying preparation.

steps.label: Assessment response observer terminated
steps.summary: The test could not retain its response during navigation.
steps.purpose: Preserve the first eager-response observer failure and unavailable stopping capture.
steps.expected: Retain the exact backend assessment resolution before the interface frame is removed.
steps.actual: The response-body observer terminated when the interface frame navigated away. The browser stopped before a stopping screenshot or finalized trace could be captured. No engineering run or review was executed; fresh011 verifies the real assessment separately.
